resources.string: Start a read-only TFTP server on your local network.

TFTP has no authentication or encryption. Anyone who can reach this device on the network may download readable files from the selected folder. Uploads are disabled. Use only on a trusted local network.
TFTP read-only server active on UDP port %1$d
Choose a UDP port between 1025 and 65535.
The shared folder is unavailable or cannot be read.
